objects.name: Analytic 2145
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a Linux process invoking Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor write Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) or Open Platform Communications (OPC) Unified Architecture (UA) write calls to setpoint tags on field devices, from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with the authorized control application, with values exceeding the safe operating range. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
